lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Reporting in.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Within the purview of our allotted reconnaissance, nothing abnormal was found.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Although the concentration of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere has increased slightly,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: we do not feel this will result in any significant issues.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: That concludes my report.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I'll convey my findings next.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Neon reported to us that she was hearing strange sounds that could have been some kind of signal,

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: but it was later determined to most likely have been tinnitus.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: And then...

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Signal.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: It is imperative that reports are kept quick and concise.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Sorry...
It's all right, take your time.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Commander, if you're too lax with her, she may end up becoming entitled.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: It would be advisable to be somewhat stringent at times.
Understood.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: It's not a major issue, but it is my fault, and I apologize in advance.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Do you remember the sprout I told you about last time?
The one Delta gave to you?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: In order to avoid any potential misunderstandings,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I'd like to reiterate that the flower was brought back for research purposes,

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: not purely as a gift to Signal.
How's it doing now?

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: It's grown so quick, you wouldn't believe it.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: A white flower even bloomed on it!
That's great.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I still haven't got a clue what it's called yet, though.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I even went to the library and searched the database,

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: but couldn't turn anything up.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I feel bad for it, growing up without a name,

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: so I've come up with the perfect moniker for it.
How'd you come up with a suitable name?

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I wanted to come up with something that

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I feel embodies what this flower represents.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Is there a specific concept that this flower represents to you?

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Yep!

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Its appearance reminds me of a white aster,

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: which is a flower which represents 'trust'.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: What do you think?
Very nice.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I think it's good too.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: How did you come up with the notion of trust, though?

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: It's something that I want to convey to you, Delta.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I've always got your back,

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: so you can trust me.

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: I have some important work to attend to. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: do you think Delta is upset?

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Did I say something wrong?
Don't worry.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I'm so confused...
Delta is quite pleased, I assure you.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Well, that's a relief.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I better go look for her.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: I'll be in touch.
